claim.en: Asking questions about my body is naughty.
claim.hg: Apni body ke baare mein sawaal poochna naughty baat hai.

fact.en: It is good to ask! Your body is yours, and learning about it helps you look after it. You can ask Mummy, Papa, a teacher or a doctor any question about your body. No question is silly.
fact.hg: Poochna achhi baat hai! Tumhari body tumhari hai, aur uske baare mein seekhne se tum uska khayal rakh paate ho. Tum Mummy, Papa, teacher ya doctor se apni body ke baare mein koi bhi sawaal pooch sakte ho. Koi bhi sawaal silly nahi hota.

why.en: Grown-ups sometimes feel shy, say 'chup' or change the topic. Then children think the question was wrong. It was not wrong.
why.hg: Kabhi-kabhi bade khud shy feel karte hain, 'chup' bol dete hain ya topic change kar dete hain. Tab bachchon ko lagta hai ki sawaal galat tha. Sawaal galat nahi tha.

claim.en: The vagina and the vulva are the same thing.
claim.hg: Vagina aur vulva same cheez hain.

fact.en: They are two different parts. The vulva is everything visible on the outside: the labia, the clitoris and the openings of the urethra and vagina. The vagina is the muscular passage inside the body that connects the vulva to the uterus. Using the right word matters when you describe a symptom to a doctor.
fact.hg: Yeh do alag parts hain. Vulva woh sab kuch hai jo bahar dikhta hai: labia, clitoris aur urethra aur vagina ki openings. Vagina body ke andar ka muscular passage hai jo vulva ko uterus se connect karta hai. Doctor ko koi symptom batate time sahi word use karna bahut kaam aata hai.

why.en: Most people only ever hear the word vagina used for the whole area, in conversation, adverts and even some textbooks, so the mix-up gets passed on.
why.hg: Zyadatar log baat-cheet, ads aur kuch textbooks mein bhi poore area ke liye bas vagina word hi sunte hain, isliye yeh mix-up aage pass hota rehta hai.

claim.en: The mother's body decides whether the baby is a boy or a girl.
claim.hg: Baby ladka hoga ya ladki, yeh maa ki body decide karti hai.

fact.en: Every egg carries an X chromosome. Each sperm carries either an X or a Y. If an X sperm fertilises the egg, the baby is typically female (XX); if a Y sperm does, typically male (XY). Which sperm arrives first is pure chance, and nobody can control or cause it. Blaming a woman for having daughters has no basis in biology.
fact.hg: Har egg mein X chromosome hota hai. Har sperm mein ya toh X hota hai ya Y. Agar X wala sperm egg ko fertilise karta hai, toh baby typically female (XX) hota hai; agar Y wala karta hai, toh typically male (XY). Kaun sa sperm pehle pahunchega, yeh pure chance hai, aur ise koi na control kar sakta hai, na cause kar sakta hai. Betiyan hone par aurat ko blame karne ka biology mein koi base nahi hai.

why.en: For generations, many families valued sons and held the mother responsible for the outcome. The chromosome science is rarely explained at home, so the blame continued unchallenged.
why.hg: Generations se kai families beton ko zyada value deti aayi hain aur result ki zimmedari maa par daalti rahi hain. Chromosome ka science ghar par shayad hi kabhi explain hota hai, isliye yeh blame bina sawaal ke chalta raha.

claim.en: Most of the clitoris is hidden inside the body.
claim.hg: Clitoris ka zyadatar part body ke andar chhupa hota hai.

fact.en: True. The small visible glans is only the tip. Behind it, a shaft, two arms (crura) and two bulbs of erectile tissue extend several centimetres inside, around the vaginal opening. Anatomists described this in the 1800s, but many later textbooks drew only part of it. Dissection and MRI studies from the late 1990s onwards brought the full shape back into view, which is why many older diagrams show just a dot or leave it out.
fact.hg: Sahi hai. Bahar dikhne wala chhota glans bas iska tip hai. Uske peeche ek shaft, do arms (crura) aur erectile tissue ke do bulbs vaginal opening ke around kai centimetre andar tak phaile hote hain. Anatomists ne 1800s mein hi ise describe kar diya tha, par baad ki kai textbooks mein iska bas ek part dikhaya gaya. Late 1990s se hui dissection aur MRI studies ne iski full shape wapas saamne rakhi, isiliye kai purane diagrams mein yeh bas ek dot jaisa dikhta hai ya hota hi nahi.

why.en: School diagrams focus on the organs needed for reproduction, and anatomy linked to sensation in women was long treated as too embarrassing to draw or discuss.
why.hg: School ke diagrams reproduction ke liye zaroori organs par hi focus karte hain, aur women mein sensation se judi anatomy ko lambe time tak itna embarrassing maana gaya ki na use draw kiya gaya, na us par baat hui.

claim.en: Being intersex is a disease that has to be corrected.
claim.hg: Intersex hona ek bimaari hai jise theek karna zaroori hai.

fact.en: Intersex variations are natural differences in chromosomes, hormones or anatomy. Most intersex people are physically healthy. A few specific conditions need medical care, for example for hormone or salt balance, but that is different from surgery done only to make a body look typical. Such decisions should involve the person themselves wherever possible. Being intersex is not an illness.
fact.hg: Intersex variations chromosomes, hormones ya anatomy ke natural differences hain. Zyadatar intersex log physically healthy hote hain. Kuch specific conditions mein medical care chahiye hoti hai, jaise hormone ya salt balance ke liye, lekin yeh us surgery se alag baat hai jo sirf body ko typical dikhane ke liye ki jaye. Aise decisions mein jahan tak ho sake us insaan ki apni rai shamil honi chahiye. Intersex hona koi bimaari nahi hai.

why.en: Because bodies are usually sorted into just two boxes, anything outside them gets treated as a defect, and families often keep it secret out of fear of gossip.
why.hg: Bodies ko usually sirf do boxes mein sort kiya jata hai, isliye jo unse bahar ho use defect maan liya jata hai, aur families aksar logon ki baaton ke darr se ise secret rakhti hain.

claim.en: The testicles hang outside the body because they need to stay cooler.
claim.hg: Testicles body ke bahar isliye latakte hain kyunki unhe thoda cool rehna hota hai.

fact.en: True. Sperm develop best at a temperature slightly lower than the rest of the body, which is why the testes sit in the scrotum rather than inside the belly. The scrotum adjusts on its own: it tightens and pulls the testes closer when it is cold and hangs looser when it is warm. That changing look through the day is normal.
fact.hg: Sahi hai. Sperm baaki body se thode kam temperature par best develop hote hain, isiliye testes pet ke andar nahi, scrotum mein hote hain. Scrotum apne aap adjust karta hai: thand mein tight hokar testes ko body ke paas kheench leta hai aur garmi mein loose hokar latak jata hai. Din bhar mein iska aise badalte rehna normal hai.

why.en: It sounds like a joke or a guess, because most people are never told why the body is built this way. In this case the playground explanation happens to be correct.
why.hg: Yeh joke ya tukka jaisa lagta hai, kyunki zyadatar logon ko kabhi bataya hi nahi jata ki body aisi kyun bani hai. Is case mein doston se suni hui baat sach nikalti hai.

claim.en: A bigger penis means a man is more masculine and more fertile.
claim.hg: Penis jitna bada, aadmi utna hi zyada mard aur utna hi zyada fertile.

fact.en: Penis size is decided by genes and hormones during puberty, like height or shoe size. It has no connection with sperm count, fertility, strength, courage or character. Fertility depends on the health of the sperm made in the testes. Products that promise enlargement, such as oils, tablets and pumps, do not change size, and some cause injury or skin damage.
fact.hg: Penis ka size puberty ke dauraan genes aur hormones se decide hota hai, jaise height ya shoe size. Iska sperm count, fertility, taakat, himmat ya character se koi connection nahi hai. Fertility testes mein banne wale sperm ki health par depend karti hai. Enlargement ka promise karne wale tel, tablets aur pumps size nahi badalte, aur kuch se injury ya skin damage ho sakta hai.

why.en: Jokes, films, adult content and adverts for 'power' products all repeat the idea. Because boys rarely get accurate information, the anxiety hardens into accepted truth.
why.hg: Jokes, films, adult content aur 'power' products ke ads, sab yahi idea repeat karte hain. Ladkon ko sahi information kam hi milti hai, isliye yeh anxiety dheere-dheere accepted truth ban jaati hai.
